metadata.title: Two Thresholds for Globular Cluster Formation and their Dominance of Star Formation in the Early-Universe

notes: No eligible stars. The paper studies globular cluster and young massive cluster formation and high-redshift star-forming regions, not identifiable individual Galactic stars. Its reference to “unbound stars” is a generic population statement, e.g. “Young massive clusters (YMCs) are usually accompanied by lower-mass clusters and unbound stars...” (T:p1-b3), not a claim about any identified star.
